# seed_phrase_project fixture

For `secrets.seed_phrase_detected` (tests/checkers/test_secrets.py).

`wallet-notes.txt` contains the alphabetically-first 12 words of the
public-domain BIP-39 English wordlist, one run, space-separated -- a
seed-phrase-SHAPED value for testing, not a real wallet's phrase.
`config.yaml` is ordinary clean content and must never trigger a finding.
